title: AuthProvider::auth_header forces &'static str for header name — API lock-in
description: fn auth_header(&self) -> Option<(&'static str, &str)> — the first element requires the header name be 'static. All three built-in implementations return the literal "authorization", which is static. But any custom AuthProvider that computes its header name (e.g. X-Api-Key, X-HMAC-Signature, or a per-request nonce prefix) must either use a string literal or Box::leak, both of which are unergonomic or wrong. The natural signature is fn auth_header(&self) -> Option<(&str, &str)> with both lifetimes tied to &self. The 'static constraint on the name provides no benefit — the built-in implementations would still compile. This will fossilize once external crates implement AuthProvider. Pre-1.0: change is breaking for any downstream implementor but the audience is small now.
